tagline: 理光便携相机，1995 年发布
description: 理光于1995年推出的便携相机。配备38mm f/4.5 - 130mm f/9.5, 6 elements in 3 groups。快门速度2 sec. - 1/330 sec.。感光度ISO 50 - 3200 (DX-code system)。7-point multi autofocus with single AF facility, 1024 focusing steps, Passive Autofocus with auxiliary AF light。

specs.对焦: 7-point multi autofocus with single AF facility, 1024 focusing steps, Passive Autofocus with auxiliary AF light
specs.闪光灯: Zoom flash, G.N. 17 - 21 (ISO 100/m), Auto/ On/ Off, Slow synchro, Red-eye reduction, Red-eye reduction slow synchro
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh Myport 330 Super is an autofocus compact camera for 35mm film, introduced by Ricoh in 1995.
